title: MZ where is my dlc folder

posts.author: Thebeanguy
posts.body:
I heard there's a plugin that comes with RPG Maker that lets you move your side-view battlers to a new position. I want them at the bottom rather than on the right. only issue is, every form I scour says this plugin is in the DLC folder...
I don't have a DLC folder... or at least I don't see it.
I bought my version of rpgmaker through the website rather than Steam.
Is there just something I'm missing? or?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The DLC folder is simply where you decide to store the downloaded resources.
The non-steam RM remembers the last folder opened by hitting the DLC button, so simply navigate to whereever you stored your RM-downloads. You get those downloads either from the additional links in the emails or from the various posts here on the forum where the news of a bonus was posted.
in the steam-version that is all automated by being linked to the steam-DLC folder, and the free resources are automatically downloaded and place there.
But that is the only difference, you don't get or miss any DLC from getting the standalone or the steam version.
and if you don't want to search for the links, as said above the same key you got for the standalone can be used to activate the program on steam. It's the same licence
